block-secret-access.title: Block Secret File Access
block-secret-access.description: Refuse to read, write, or print .env files, private keys, .netrc, and service-account JSON

block-force-push.title: Block Force Push
block-force-push.description: Refuse git push --force without --force-with-lease, and pushes aimed at main/master/HEAD

block-history-rewrite.title: Block History Rewrite
block-history-rewrite.description: Refuse git commands that irreversibly discard uncommitted work

block-destructive-bash.title: Block Destructive Bash
block-destructive-bash.description: Refuse recursive deletes of a root, curl-piped-to-shell, sudo, and destructive SQL

session-git-status.title: Session Git Status
session-git-status.description: Report the repository's state at the start of a session
